title: Add Jobs API

context.summary: Expose processing job status, listing and retry through the HTTP API, CLI and MCP tools.
context.background: Upload and worker tasks create durable processing jobs, but users and adapters need HTTP visibility and retry operations for MVP acceptance.

in: Wire jobs routes to the API runtime job store and dispatcher.
Update CLI job retry to include project id and expose MCP job tools.
Update docs and validation scripts for jobs API behavior.
out: Implement scheduled retries or dead-letter policy beyond manual retry.

acceptance_criteria: ProcessingJobStore supports getJob, listJobs and resetJobForRetry.
DbProcessingJobStore implements project-scoped job get/list/retry operations.
API runtime registers and wires processing job routes.
Job routes enforce project authorization and return structured job responses.
Retry resets a job to pending and re-enqueues it through BullMQ.
CLI and MCP can call job list/get/retry through HTTP.
Docs and validations describe job status visibility.

manual_checks: Confirm no token management endpoints were added.
Confirm worker processing behavior is unchanged.

risks: Retry is manual and project-scoped; automated dead-letter handling remains future work.
Job API behavior is structurally validated but not exercised against live PostgreSQL/Redis in this task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
